name: git-braid
description: High-performance, AI-assisted git graph visualisation for VS Code

commands.title: Git Braid: Clear Stored AI API Key

gitBraid.initialCommitLoad.description: Number of commits to load on initial graph open.

enumDescriptions: Relative time (e.g. 3 days ago). Falls back to absolute for dates older than ~30 days.
gitBraid.dateFormat.description: How commit timestamps are displayed in the detail panel.

gitBraid.graphColors.description: Override the graph lane colour cycle (array of CSS colour strings, e.g. ["#ff6b6b", "#4ecdc4"]). Leave empty to use the built-in palette.

gitBraid.ai.enabled.description: Enable AI-assisted features (opt-in). When enabled, commit data (subjects, authors, and optionally diff stats) is sent to the configured LLM provider. You will be asked to confirm before each operation.

enumDescriptions: VS Code Language Model API — uses your existing AI extension (e.g. GitHub Copilot). No API key required.
Anthropic Claude — BYO API key (stored in SecretStorage, not settings).
OpenAI — BYO API key (stored in SecretStorage, not settings).
Google Gemini — BYO API key (stored in SecretStorage, not settings).
Groq — BYO API key (stored in SecretStorage, not settings).
gitBraid.ai.provider.description: Which AI provider to use for release-notes generation. API keys for BYO providers are stored in VS Code SecretStorage.

gitBraid.ai.model.description: Model name for BYO key providers. Examples: claude-opus-4-8 (Anthropic), gpt-4o (OpenAI), gemini-1.5-pro (Gemini), llama-3.3-70b-versatile (Groq). Ignored when using vscode-lm.

gitBraid.ai.defaultDiffStat.description: Pre-select 'Include diff stat' in the privacy-level picker when generating release notes. Diff stats add approximate files-changed and ±line counts to the AI prompt.
